content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison script for NTHMP BM5 (solitary wave on composite beach), Case A H/d=0.0378, written by Babak Tehranirad (header L1-27). Loads reference data A.mat (L29; t, g4..g10) and model stations sta_0001..sta_0007 into n4..n10 (L30-36). Model time rescaled /10 and shifted +261.7 s (L39-47; commented alternative t=t-261.7 L38). No-op elevation copy loop (L49-57). Reference gauges g4..g10 converted to cm over first 600 samples (L59-67). Waterfall offsets in 10-cm steps: n4/g4 +60, n5/g5 +50, n6/g6 +40, n7/g7 +30, n8/g8 +20, n9/g9 +10 (L69-85); n10/g10 no offset. Plots the seven pairs overlaid (subplots commented): measured default color vs model red (L88-121). Title 'Case A (H/d=0.0378)' (L122), axis [269 291 -0.2 8.2] (L123), labels sec/cm (L124-125), grid (L126), legend 'Measured Data'/'Numerical Simulation' SouthOutside (L133). Commented tick and wall-gauge remnants (L127-132). No writes.
entities: script variables: n4..n10 @L30-36, i @L39/L49/L59, g4..g10 (from A.mat, rescaled @L60-66), offsets applied @L69-85; t from A.mat @L29

equations.ref: model time rescale and shift (n5..n10 L41-46)
reference gauges to cm over first 600 samples (L61-66)

calls: clear all @L28; load @L29, @L30-36; length @L39, @L49; plot @L89, @L91, @L94, @L96, @L99, @L101, @L104, @L106, @L109, @L111, @L114, @L116, @L119, @L121; hold on @L90 etc.; title @L122; axis @L123; xlabel @L124; ylabel @L125; grid on @L126; legend @L133
unresolved: Waterfall offsets reach +60 cm (L69) but the axis y-range tops at 8.2 cm (L123) -- with these offsets only the unshifted gauge-10 pair falls inside the axis; the axis limits appear tuned for a different (smaller) offset scheme such as the skp=2 one in BM5_A_Plotter.m.

Model time /10 rescale (L40-46) implies 0.1-s time units in the station files; the 261.7 s shift differs from BM5_A_Plotter.m's 265.82 s for the same case directory -- which alignment is authoritative is not determinable here.
Model station elevations are not unit-converted while reference gauges are converted to cm (first 600 samples only, L59-67) -- same unit-consistency caveat as BM5_A_Plotter.m.
Header (L14-15) mentions gauge files like 'g4.txt' but data actually come from A.mat; header also says nothing needs uploading (L7-8), reflecting an NTHMP workshop template origin.
legend at L133 labels only the last plotted pair's colors on an axes holding 14 lines; the no-op copy loop L49-57 has no effect.
